name: Row-Bot
notes: Row-Bot is a local-first, open-source desktop AI workspace with no account: research with a local model and visible sources, creation with an explicit handoff to a frontier model, repeatable local automations with every run kept for inspection, and approval-gated actions that cross into the real world. Requested via the form (issue #422).
tagline: Your AI. Your machine. Your rules.

access.price: Free, open source; hosted models at your own cost
